name: System Dynamics & Modeling
summary: Building and analysing mathematical models of mechanical, electrical, fluid and thermal systems as the foundation for vibrations, control and mechatronics.

topics.name: Modeling philosophy: lumped elements, assumptions and validation
Mechanical translational and rotational systems (masses, springs, dampers, gears, levers)
Electrical and electromechanical systems (DC motors, generators)
Fluid and hydraulic systems (capacitance, resistance, inertance)
Time response of first- and second-order systems
Numerical simulation of dynamic systems (MATLAB/Simulink, Python)
